selection.roadmapLane: P2 original-request custody and local recovery
selection.finiteSlice: Connect the existing strict response parser to the opt-in V5 response-observation owner and existing-store SQLite resource owner. Six selected socketless/native-SQLite cases include legacy dispatch and V4 controls.
selection.completedWorkNotRerun: The preceding V5 owner and store outcomes, earlier V4 HTTP/runner/process cases, and old failure records are retained, not rerun.
selection.ownership: Primary implementation with independent complete joined-outcome review; no worker, automation, model selection or session was changed.

implementation.dispatcherV2: Resolve the exact canonical successful response JSON only after the existing required request/response completion/close interface events. Keep a bounded temporary string for the V2 mode, release the internal reference on settlement and retain no response string in snapshots.
implementation.dispatcherV1: The original factory now delegates to the same private implementation with response exposure false; its selected successful result remains undefined. The original public arity and exact configuration grammar are unchanged.
implementation.parser: Reuses the existing strict status, raw-header, UTF-8, bounded-byte and canonical two-field JSON validation. Response data is not reconstructed from a snapshot and no parser is duplicated.
implementation.lifecyclePreservation: The dispatcher pump/header parser and the owned child-settlement/store-close implementations remain byte-identical. Shared lifecycle code is reused rather than copied.
implementation.borrowedV5: The explicit HTTP V5 factory selects the V2 dispatcher and V5 owner. The existing owner writes and confirms its original/intent-bound declared observation before resolving submitOriginal to undefined.
implementation.ownedV5: Open only an EXISTING V5 SQLite profile and compose the V5 HTTP child. Reuse the existing resource slot, acquisition-refusal classification, synchronous admission close, cached root close identity and one store-close attempt.
implementation.startupFence: An old selected-grant unobserved intent is quarantined by the V5 owner before retention or dispatch. A foreign grant's pending intent does not quarantine the selected grant.
implementation.unknownBoundary: Strict reply failure persists selected-grant quarantine and remains UNKNOWN after normal owned close/reopen; no implicit resend occurs. A returned native store close releases only this module's resource slot, not payment or external cleanup authority.
implementation.authorization: Forward the exact declared Authorization string once to the injected request capability. Exclude it from the owner input, original/intent/response rows and snapshots. This validates syntax/declared metadata only, not a capability signature or current authority.
implementation.localResponseMeaning: Caller-supplied transport DATA, not an independently authenticated server receipt, service delivery, settlement or permission to pay/sign/send.
implementation.erasureBoundary: The private byte buffer is cleared by the existing lifecycle and the new internal response-string reference is released on settlement. Caller, fulfilled Promise and native copies may remain; secure string erasure is not promised.
implementation.lateOrNativeEventBoundary: The same reviewed interface-event and trusted requestImpl premises remain. This packet does not prove future late-event absence, hard cancellation, OS cleanup or native/network lifetime bounds.

execution.fixedInlineRunner: Node test/util/reporters/stream builtins; one exact positional fixture, six exact names and six complete diagnostics. No saved or installed operational helper.
execution.limitsBoundary: These limits are not hard lifetime, cancellation, native-cleanup or OS/network-sandbox guarantees. Native loader, runner, streams, SQLite, file sync, OS and trusted declared-handle behavior remain premises.
execution.processBoundary: Normal same-process owner/store close and reopen only. No forced termination, fresh-process recovery, actual process restart, OS restart, crash or power-loss experiment.

cases.name: Strict dispatch V2 returns canonical reply only after interface completion while V1 remains void
cases.observed: Using the existing strict parser and socketless handles, legacy V1 resolves undefined while explicit V2 resolves the exact successful canonical JSON. Neither resolves before required close events. A noncanonical extra-field reply is rejected as UNKNOWN without synthesizing success.

cases.name: Borrowed HTTP V5 persists parsed response without persisting Authorization or replaying an original
cases.observed: A borrowed V5 HTTP client writes/readbacks the actual parsed response in a new native V5 file. Foreign submit and implicit original replay produce no request. Borrowed client close does not close its store. Native rows contain no declared Authorization material.

cases.name: Owned HTTP V5 drains then reopens with original intent and response rows preserved
cases.observed: After the earlier borrowed client/store drain, an owned V5 open preserves the existing response and admits a distinct selected-grant original despite valid foreign pending work. Root close synchronously fences admission, waits for reply/observation drain, and closes the store once. Earlier rows and schema remain intact.

cases.name: Strict HTTP uncertainty persists quarantine and survives owned close and reopen without resending
cases.observed: A declared HTTP 503 reply takes the strict UNKNOWN path, stores no response observation and latches grant C quarantine. Owned close returns the store close but rejects with child UNKNOWN. A normal reopen reads the marker and blocks fresh dispatch without creating another request; all rows except owner epoch are identical.

cases.name: Owned V5 startup fences an older unobserved intent before request or retention
cases.observed: An owned V5 open detects grant B's deliberately retained old unobserved intent before any new request or retention. Same-original and new-original submits are blocked, one quarantine is confirmed, and root close remains UNKNOWN while releasing the native store.

cases.name: V4 remains a distinct void-response profile and cross-profile acquisition preserves exact files
cases.observed: Borrowed V5 refuses an incompatible V4 store before quarantine writes. Cross-profile owned acquisitions refuse without changing exact closed file bytes, identities or epochs. A later valid V4 owned open proves the slot was released and preserves the old void-result behavior, with no response table or quarantine.

preservation.originalPaymentRequestAuthority: Original payment/request bytes, hash, payload, requirements, context and consumed authority remain unchanged.
preservation.pr193: Preserve VALIDATED possible exact-same-signed-block resend separately from UNKNOWN and ACKNOWLEDGED. No resend, replacement, re-signing or settlement is executed.

preNativeStatusRefusal.cause: The newly edited dispatcher was previously clean in the tracked checkout; it added a normal owned worktree-modified status row.
preNativeStatusRefusal.resolution: HEAD and index matched the exact pre-edit dispatcher blob. Removing only that owned status row and new qualification rows recovers the complete prior unrelated-status hash. No Git reset, stage or cleanup was performed.
